title: Market Response to European Regulation of Business Combinations

context.country_region: Europe (EC regulatory review); listed firms from 19 countries, with bidders both European (EC) and non-European (many U.S.)
context.sample_description: EC-notified proposed business combinations (public offerings, mergers, and acquisitions) with publicly traded subject firms listed on national stock exchanges; the test sample requires both bidder and target listed (443 combinations / 886 firms; 68 public offerings, 64 mergers, 311 acquisitions; 169 with a non-EC bidder); stock price and volume from Datastream, announcement dates from Reuters, Bloomberg, the SDC Database, and the financial press

data_sources.name: Datastream (accessed at the Universite de Lille 2)
SDC Database edited by Thomson Financial
Financial press (Les Echos, Financial Times, The Wall Street Journal)
